# Ashwood Grocery third-party assets

All downloaded files in this directory are used as unmodified source assets
or instanced scene props. The project-owned building scenes and fixture GLBs
live under `assets/environment/buildings/AshwoodGrocery/`.

| Asset | Author / provider | Source | Local path | License |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bananas | Poly Haven contributors | https://polyhaven.com/a/bananas | `poly_haven/bananas/` | CC0 1.0 |
| Food Apple 01 | Poly Haven contributors | https://polyhaven.com/a/food_apple_01 | `poly_haven/food_apple_01/` | CC0 1.0 |
| Yellow Onion | Poly Haven contributors | https://polyhaven.com/a/yellow_onion | `poly_haven/yellow_onion/` | CC0 1.0 |
| Sweet Potato | Poly Haven contributors | https://polyhaven.com/a/sweet_potato | `poly_haven/sweet_potato/` | CC0 1.0 |
| Wicker Basket 01 | Poly Haven contributors | https://polyhaven.com/a/wicker_basket_01 | `poly_haven/wicker_basket_01/` | CC0 1.0 |
| Russian Food Cans 01 | Poly Haven contributors | https://polyhaven.com/a/russian_food_cans_01 | `poly_haven/russian_food_cans_01/` | CC0 1.0 |
| Wine Bottles 01 | Poly Haven contributors | https://polyhaven.com/a/wine_bottles_01 | `poly_haven/wine_bottles_01/` | CC0 1.0 |

The 1K glTF variants were downloaded through Poly Haven's public API on
2026-07-29. Poly Haven publishes its model library under CC0 1.0:
https://polyhaven.com/license

The Grocery also reuses already-tracked project assets from the Bakery,
Pharmacy, Diner, shared sanitary pack, common doors, and common crate folders.
Their original attribution and license records remain with those source
directories.
